finding.because: Existing substrate contains multiple machine-callable toll surfaces, but live settlement configuration and independent buyer activity are not currently observable through the connected control plane.
finding.required: One independently attributed external buyer must cross one live toll wall and receive automated fulfillment.
finding.owner_action: Only a genuine external-action or financial authorization gate. No owner fulfillment should be required.

Build a machine-readable evidence passport from durable commerce truth.

wall_model.important_boundary: A payment credential authorizes one paid capability call; it does not itself create verified revenue.

next_gate.action: If a lawful, genuinely relevant demand surface permits a useful response or listing, authorize only that specific external action. Do not authorize generic outreach or spam.
